hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Read it as a story: you had $y$ stickers, gave away $12$, and have $5$ left. How many did you start with?
$12$ is being subtracted from $y$. Use the opposite operation on both sides.
Add $12$ to both sides to cancel the subtraction. The right side becomes $5 + 12$.
$5 + 12 = 17$, so the solution of the equation is $y = 17$.

explanation: In $y - 12 = 5$, the number $12$ is subtracted from $y$.
Add $12$ to both sides, because addition undoes subtraction.
The right side becomes $5 + 12 = 17$, so the result is $y = 17$.
Check: $17 - 12 = 5$ is true, so the solution is $y = 17$.
